title: Number of 1 Bits
statement:
Write a function that takes a positive integer and returns the number of 1-bits it has in its binary representation (also known as the Hamming weight).

For example, the binary representation of 11 is 1011, which has three 1-bits.
constraints: The input must be a positive integer

visibleExamples.explanation: The binary representation of 11 is 1011, which has three 1-bits.
The binary representation of 128 is 10000000, which has one 1-bit.
